        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm install

      - run: npx cap sync
      - run: cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug

        with:
          name: perform-security-review-android-apk
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm install electron electron-builder --save-dev
      - run: npx electron-builder --linux --dir
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: perform-security-review-linux-exe
          path: dist/

    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm install electron electron-builder --save-dev
      - run: npx electron-builder --win --dir
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: perform-security-review-windows-exe
          path: dist/
